name: EnergyPlus version
method: Reads the version identifier directly from the Version object.
assumptions: Accepted versions are checked elsewhere; this metric only reports the value found in the model.
missingData: Shown as — when no Version object or version identifier is present.

name: Building name
method: Reads the Building object name field.
assumptions: The first Building object is used when more than one is present.
missingData: Shown as — when no Building name is present.

name: Building north axis
method: Reads the numeric north-axis rotation.
assumptions: This rotation is added to calculated surface azimuths for orientation bins.
missingData: Shown as — when the field is blank or nonnumeric.

name: Object count
source: Parsed IDF or epJSON object list.
method: Counts all parsed objects.
assumptions: No filtering is applied.
missingData: Always available; zero means the input contains no parsed objects.

name: Object type count
source: Parsed IDF or epJSON object list.
method: Counts distinct object type names.
assumptions: Type names are compared exactly after parsing.
missingData: Always available; zero means the input contains no parsed object types.

name: Zone count
method: Counts Zone objects with or without names.
assumptions: Spaces are not counted as zones.
missingData: Always available; zero means no Zone objects were found.

name: Space count
method: Counts Space objects.
assumptions: The metric is independent from Zone count.
missingData: Always available; zero means no Space objects were found.

name: Schedule count
source: Objects whose type starts with Schedule:.
method: Counts all schedule objects.
assumptions: ScheduleTypeLimits is not counted as a schedule.
missingData: Always available; zero means no schedule objects were found.

name: Construction count
source: Objects whose type starts with Construction.
method: Counts construction objects.
assumptions: All Construction:* variants are included.
missingData: Always available; zero means no construction objects were found.

name: Material count
method: Counts opaque and window material objects.
assumptions: Construction objects are excluded.
missingData: Always available; zero means no material objects were found.

name: Gross floor area
source: Zone floor fields and floor surfaces.
method: Sums zone floor area fields when present; otherwise sums Floor surface polygon or rectangle areas.
assumptions: Zone multipliers are applied. Surface-derived floor area includes all floor surfaces assigned to zones.
missingData: Shown as — when no numeric zone floor area or floor surface area can be computed.

name: Conditioned floor area
source: Gross floor area and conditioned-zone detection.
method: Sums floor area for zones referenced by ZoneHVAC, ZoneHVAC:EquipmentConnections, or ZoneControl:Thermostat objects.
assumptions: Zone multipliers are applied. Only zones with known floor area can contribute.
missingData: Shown as — when conditioned zones or floor areas cannot be identified.

name: Unconditioned floor area
method: Subtracts conditioned floor area from gross floor area.
assumptions: The value is clamped at zero to avoid negative results from partial data.
missingData: Shown as — when gross or conditioned floor area is unavailable.

name: Footprint area
method: Sums ground-contact floor surfaces, or the lowest horizontal floor surfaces when ground boundary data is absent.
assumptions: Zone multipliers are applied to surface areas. Bounding-box dimensions are reported separately and are not used as footprint area.
missingData: Shown as — when no floor surface area can be computed.

name: Bounding box area
method: Calculates the XY bounding-box area from all detailed vertices.
assumptions: This is a coarse geometric extent, not a true footprint polygon.
missingData: Shown as — when detailed vertex extents are unavailable.

name: Total zone volume
source: Zone and Space volume fields, floor areas, and resolved heights.
method: Uses numeric Zone Volume first, otherwise resolves the independent Zone volume from zone floor area and height; resolved Space volumes are a fallback only when Zone dimensions are unavailable.
assumptions: Zone multipliers are applied exactly once. A declared Space Volume does not override its parent Zone volume. Estimated or incompletely resolved values are marked partial.
missingData: Shown as — when neither declared nor estimated zone volume is available.

name: Average floor height
source: Zone / Ceiling Height and detailed surface extents.
method: Averages numeric zone ceiling heights; falls back to max-min vertex Z height by zone.
assumptions: Each zone contributes once; autocalculate fields require geometry fallback.
missingData: Shown as — when no zone height can be read or inferred.

name: Building long side
method: Uses the larger of the model XY bounding-box width and depth.
assumptions: Only detailed vertices are considered.
missingData: Shown as — when detailed vertex coordinates are unavailable.

name: Building short side
method: Uses the smaller nonzero side of the model XY bounding box.
assumptions: Only detailed vertices are considered.
missingData: Shown as — when detailed vertex coordinates are unavailable or one side is zero.

name: Footprint aspect ratio
method: Divides building long side by building short side.
assumptions: A value of 1.0 indicates a square bounding footprint.
missingData: Shown as — when either side length is unavailable.

name: Gross envelope area
source: Exterior walls, roofs, and ground floors.
method: Sums exterior opaque wall area, roof area, and ground-contact floor area.
assumptions: Fenestration is not subtracted from opaque base surfaces; see net opaque envelope area for the subtracted value.
missingData: Shown as — when no envelope surface area can be computed.

name: Net opaque envelope area
source: Gross envelope area and fenestration area.
method: Subtracts recognized window and opaque door area from gross envelope area.
assumptions: This is an analyzer area balance and depends on resolved fenestration geometry.
missingData: Shown as — when gross envelope area cannot be computed.

name: Envelope area to volume ratio
source: Envelope area and total zone volume.
method: Divides envelope area by total zone volume.
assumptions: Uses partial volume estimates when declared volumes are incomplete.
missingData: Shown as — when envelope area or volume is unavailable.

name: Floor area to volume ratio
source: Gross floor area and total zone volume.
method: Divides gross floor area by total zone volume.
assumptions: Uses partial volume estimates when declared volumes are incomplete.
missingData: Shown as — when floor area or volume is unavailable.

name: Exterior wall area
source: Building wall surfaces with exterior boundary conditions.
method: Sums Wall surfaces exposed to Outdoors or exterior wall object types.
assumptions: Zone multipliers are applied. Wall area is gross wall area.
missingData: Shown as — when no exterior wall area can be computed.

name: Roof area
method: Sums exterior roof or roof/ceiling surface area.
assumptions: Zone multipliers are applied.
missingData: Shown as — when no roof surface area can be computed.

name: Ground floor area
source: Floor surfaces with Ground boundary or lowest floor fallback.
method: Sums floor surfaces adjacent to ground; uses lowest floor surfaces when boundary data is absent.
assumptions: Zone multipliers are applied.
missingData: Shown as — when no ground or lowest floor area can be computed.

name: Window area
method: Sums fenestration objects whose surface type indicates window or glass door.
assumptions: Fenestration multipliers and base-zone multipliers are applied.
missingData: Shown as — when no window area can be computed.

name: Door area
method: Sums non-glazed door area from detailed or rectangular geometry.
assumptions: Fenestration multipliers and base-zone multipliers are applied.
missingData: Shown as — when no door area can be computed.

name: Total WWR
source: Exterior wall area and window area.
method: Divides total window area by gross exterior wall area.
assumptions: Glass doors count as window area. Wall area is gross and not net of windows.
missingData: Shown as — when wall area is zero or unavailable.

name: North WWR
method: Divides north-facing window area by north-facing exterior wall area.
assumptions: North is [315,360) plus [0,45) degrees after building and zone rotations.
missingData: Shown as — when no north-facing exterior wall area is available.

name: East WWR
method: Divides east-facing window area by east-facing exterior wall area.
assumptions: East is [45,135) degrees after building and zone rotations.
missingData: Shown as — when no east-facing exterior wall area is available.

name: South WWR
method: Divides south-facing window area by south-facing exterior wall area.
assumptions: South is [135,225) degrees after building and zone rotations.
missingData: Shown as — when no south-facing exterior wall area is available.

name: West WWR
method: Divides west-facing window area by west-facing exterior wall area.
assumptions: West is [225,315) degrees after building and zone rotations.
missingData: Shown as — when no west-facing exterior wall area is available.

name: Skylight roof ratio
source: Window area on roof base surfaces and roof area.
method: Divides skylight window area by roof area.
assumptions: A fenestration object is treated as skylight when its base surface is a roof.
missingData: Shown as — when roof area is zero or no skylight area can be identified.

name: Total lighting power
method: Sums LightingLevel directly and resolves Watts/Area or Watts/Person methods where supporting area or people data is available.
assumptions: Zone and ZoneList references are expanded where possible; zone multipliers are applied.
missingData: Shown as — when no lighting design level can be computed.

name: Average lighting power density
method: Divides total lighting power by conditioned floor area, falling back to gross floor area.
assumptions: Partial lighting or floor-area inputs produce a partial status.
missingData: Shown as — when lighting power or floor area is unavailable.

name: Total equipment power
source: ElectricEquipment, GasEquipment, HotWaterEquipment, SteamEquipment, and OtherEquipment objects.
method: Sums direct design levels and resolves Watts/Area, Power/Area, Watts/Person, or Power/Person methods where supporting area or people data is available.
assumptions: Zone and ZoneList references are expanded where possible; zone multipliers are applied.
missingData: Shown as — when no equipment design level can be computed.

name: Average equipment power density
method: Divides total equipment power by conditioned floor area, falling back to gross floor area.
assumptions: Partial equipment or floor-area inputs produce a partial status.
missingData: Shown as — when equipment power or floor area is unavailable.

name: Total people
method: Sums People, People/Area, or Area/Person methods where supporting floor area is available.
assumptions: Zone and ZoneList references are expanded where possible; zone multipliers are applied.
missingData: Shown as — when no people count can be computed.

name: People density
method: Divides total people by floor area and scales to 100 m2.
assumptions: Conditioned floor area is preferred; gross floor area is used as fallback.
missingData: Shown as — when people count or floor area is unavailable.

name: Internal load object count
source: People, Lights, ElectricEquipment, GasEquipment, HotWaterEquipment, SteamEquipment, and OtherEquipment objects.
method: Counts the supported internal load objects represented in these metrics.
assumptions: Specialized internal gains with different sizing models are excluded.
missingData: Always available; zero means no supported internal load objects were found.

name: Internal load method coverage
source: People, Lights, ElectricEquipment, GasEquipment, HotWaterEquipment, SteamEquipment, and OtherEquipment calculation methods.
method: Reports resolved_objects / total_objects and unresolved_method_count for supported internal load metric objects.
assumptions: A method is unresolved when the required people, floor-area, or design-level fields cannot be resolved.
missingData: Always available; zero totals mean no supported internal load objects were found.

name: Referenced schedule count
source: Fields whose comments include Schedule Name.
method: Counts distinct schedule names referenced by non-schedule objects.
assumptions: Schedule names are matched case-insensitively after trimming.
missingData: Always available; zero means no schedule references were found.

name: Supported annual schedule count
method: Counts schedules whose annual active hours can be evaluated by the v1 parser.
assumptions: Schedule value greater than zero is treated as active.
missingData: Always available; zero means no supported annual schedules were found.

name: Unsupported schedule count
method: Subtracts supported schedules from total schedule objects.
assumptions: Unsupported schedules remain visible so operating-hour results can be interpreted.
missingData: Always available; zero means every schedule was supported or no schedules exist.

name: Representative operating hours
method: Uses the maximum active annual hours among referenced supported schedules; falls back to all supported schedules.
assumptions: A non-leap 8760-hour year is used. Compact weekday/weekend rules use a fixed Monday-start annual calendar.
missingData: Shown as — when no supported schedule hours are available.

name: Average schedule operating hours
method: Averages annual active hours across supported schedules.
assumptions: A non-leap 8760-hour year is used. Schedule value greater than zero is active.
missingData: Shown as — when no supported schedule hours are available.

name: HVAC object count
method: Counts objects whose types indicate HVAC, air loops, plant loops, coils, fans, pumps, boilers, chillers, or setpoint managers.
assumptions: This is a broad inventory count, not a system simulation result.
missingData: Always available; zero means no recognized HVAC objects were found.

name: Zone HVAC object count
method: Counts objects whose type starts with ZoneHVAC:.
assumptions: ZoneHVAC:EquipmentConnections is included.
missingData: Always available; zero means no ZoneHVAC objects were found.

name: Thermostat count
method: Counts thermostat control and setpoint objects.
assumptions: Both controllers and setpoint definitions are included.
missingData: Always available; zero means no thermostat objects were found.

name: Conditioned zone count
source: ZoneHVAC, SpaceHVAC, and thermostat zone references.
method: Counts distinct zones referenced by ZoneHVAC, SpaceHVAC, ZoneHVAC:EquipmentConnections, or ZoneControl:Thermostat objects.
assumptions: ZoneList references are expanded when a matching ZoneList object exists. SpaceHVAC references are mapped through Space parent zones.
missingData: Always available; zero means no conditioned-zone references were found.

name: Conditioned zone evidence
method: Counts conditioned zones separately by equipment connections, ZoneHVAC objects, thermostat controls, and SpaceHVAC objects.
assumptions: A zone may appear in more than one evidence bucket; the total conditioned zone count is deduplicated.
missingData: Always available; zero buckets mean no conditioned-zone references were found.

name: HVAC node connection count
method: Counts typed inlet-to-outlet edges produced by AnalyzeHVAC for parsed loop branch components.
assumptions: The result is an analyzer topology count, not a full EnergyPlus simulation solve.
missingData: Always available; zero means no typed loop component edges were parsed.

name: Geometry coverage
method: Compares surfaces/fenestration with usable detailed vertices against geometry-bearing objects.
assumptions: Simple geometry objects are counted as uncovered because detailed polygon checks cannot verify them.
missingData: Always available; zero means no detailed geometry was available.

name: Profile coverage
source: Schedule references and supported annual-hour parser.
method: Divides referenced schedules that can be evaluated for annual hours by all referenced schedules.
assumptions: Unreferenced schedules are excluded from this readiness metric.
missingData: Shown as — when no schedule references are present.

name: HVAC rule edge count
method: Counts HVAC graph edges that were created from EnergyPlus object and field rules.
assumptions: Only rule-resolved edges are counted; invalid relations remain diagnostics.
missingData: Always available; zero means no HVAC rule edges were resolved.

name: Diagnostics by source
method: Counts diagnostics grouped by source such as energyplus_rule, analyzer_limitation, user_quality_check, or heuristic_inference.
assumptions: Counts depend on the analyzer diagnostic rules enabled in this build.
missingData: Always available; empty means no diagnostics were emitted.

name: Output readiness
method: Compares requested simulation outputs against the standard output groups recognized by the analyzer.
assumptions: This is a reporting-readiness metric and does not guarantee a successful simulation.
missingData: Always available; zero means no recognized output requests were present.
